notes: C1 is judged 'partly' because the review notes the high structured background in the AC map (P8), individual normalization hiding relative intensities between AC and ZZ (P12, P19), and cross-section/absorption differences between AC and ZZ (P6, P10), which would lead to the same explanation, without explicitly phrasing it as a signal-to-noise ratio discrepancy. C6 is judged 'partly' because P18 discusses how opposite hole dynamics under ZZ pumping affect electron-hole pair nonvolatility and optical readout for valleytronics, but does not ask about comparison to materials where electron and hole dynamics are not reversed.
